{{Quote|The horranths are everywhere lately. Hulking, razor-mawed monsters with nasty dispositions.|Sedni Maruk|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Horranths''' were reptilian [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]] native to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Quadrupeds with short, stubby legs and an array of horns across their back, horranths were typically seen in few numbers on the grassy mountainsides of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

Possessing a high birthrate, horranth matriarchs could lay hundreds of [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] but were often constrained by a limited food supply. When [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] was plentiful, the high horranth birthrate saw a sharp increase in their numbers. Congregating in large family groups, or broods, horranths often depleted their habitat's resources after a population boom.<ref name="TOR:codex" />

The '''mouse horranth''' was a diminutive, domesticated, version of the larger predatory horranth.<ref name="TOR:CM">[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]]</ref>
